decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - As the building has a Grade 2 listing it is important to make sure that the extension is of a high quality design and finish. It is considered that painting the external brickwork of the extension white would be in keeping with the character and appearance of other buildings in the conservation area and is therefore in keeping with the provisions of Policy ENV B2.2 - Conservation Areas of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 which aims to maintain and enhance the character and appearance of conservation areas.

Condition : 2 - Informative:  The brickwork of the extension shall be built as appropriately as possible in terms of colour, texture, mortar jointing and pointing (i.e. lime, flush and tampered finish, no cement etc).
description: Following approval for erection of a single storey side extension to existing dwellinghouse details submitted pursuant to Condition 4 (four face brick) of approved planning permission reference 00185/15/P3 dated 26/10/2004.
